author: Microsoft
description:
At a moment some are calling the “Mythos Moment” for artificial intelligence, the conversation around technology is shifting in real time. In this episode of Tools and Weapons, Microsoft's Vice Chair and President Brad Smith sit down with former UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak, now working at the center of global AI policy and innovation, to explore what happens when breakthroughs move faster than the systems built to govern them. From the risks that could define this era to the choices leaders must make now, this is a candid look at the decisions shaping the future of AI, work, and global security. Listen in for a conversation that raises as many questions as it answers and why getting this moment right matters more than ever.
